shellCommands.command: curl -s http://localhost:3000 | head -40 && echo "---ADD---" && curl -s -D - -o /tmp/add.html -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Cold+and+quiet." && echo "---BOOK---" && ID=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('data/books.json'))[0]['id'])") && curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID" | head -30 && echo "---FINISH---" && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish" && echo "---HOME---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000 | rg -n "Currently|Finished|Left Hand|empty" && echo "---JSON---" && cat data/books.json
curl -sv --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ ; echo EXIT:$?; ss -ltnp | head -20; ps aux | rg "node server" | head
node server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/books-server.pid; sleep 0.3; cat /tmp/books-server.log; curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | head -20

curl -s -D - -o /tmp/add.html -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Cold and quiet." && echo "---JSON---" && cat data/books.json && ID=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('data/books.json'))[0]['id'])") && echo "---BOOK $ID---" && curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$ID" | python3 -c "import sys,re; html=sys.stdin.read(); print(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',html))" && echo "---FINISH---" && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$ID/finish" && echo "---HOME TEXT---" && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | python3 -c "import sys,re; html=sys.stdin.read(); text=re.sub(r'<style[\s\S]*?</style>','',html); text=re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',text); print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text))"
